47  The Group has a process whereby periodically all long term contracts (including derivative contracts) are assessed for
     material foreseeable losses. At the year end, the Group has reviewed and ensured that adequate provision as required
    under any law/accounting standards for material foreseeable losses on such long term contracts (including derivative
     contracts) has been made in the books of accounts.
